description: A shell script for one-time host setup of rootless OpenClaw in Podman, including configuration, image handling, environment setup, and optional systemd service installation.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Determines if the current user is root.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: validate_single_line_value
methods.description: Ensures a value does not contain control characters.

methods.name: validate_absolute_path
methods.description: Checks if a path is absolute and does not contain control characters or dot segments.

methods.name: validate_mount_source_path
methods.description: Validates a mount source path, ensuring it's an absolute path without colons.

methods.name: validate_container_name
methods.description: Ensures the container name matches allowed character patterns.

methods.name: validate_image_name
methods.description: Checks if image name is valid and not using disallowed transport prefixes.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_dir
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists and is safe to use (not a symlink).

methods.name: stat_uid
methods.description: Retrieves the UID of a file or directory.

methods.name: stat_mode
methods.description: Retrieves the permission mode of a file or directory.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_dir_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists, is owned by the current user, and is not group-writable.

methods.name: ensure_safe_write_file_path
methods.description: Checks if a file path is safe for writing: not a symlink, exists beforehand, or is a valid path.

methods.name: write_file_atomically
methods.description: Writes content to a file atomically with specified permissions.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Checks if a port value is a number within valid range.

methods.name: escape_sed_replacement_pipe_delim
methods.description: Escapes characters in a string for safe use in sed replacement.

methods.name: resolve_user_home
methods.description: Resolves the home directory of a specified user.

methods.name: generate_token_hex_32
methods.description: Generates a secure 32-byte hex token using available tools.

methods.name: seed_local_control_ui_origins
methods.description: Seeds allowed origins in a JSON config file to include localhost and 127.0.0.1 with specified port.

methods.name: upsert_env_var
methods.description: Sets or updates an environment variable in a file.
